integrity: The infinite result is proved symbolically. Finite exhaustive checks through order 10 are supplementary regression evidence and are not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for connected complete multipartite graphs.

Full text of the two upper-parameter journal papers was not available from the accessible open sources; their abstracts and bibliographic records were inspected, leaving a residual literature-coverage risk.
title: Upper signed total domination of complete multipartite graphs
